div.span: Every start, install, repair, resume and uninstall passes one transition function and writes the record before each OS step. A hold ends when the service answers, the version changes, or the user presses Repair. macOS and Linux share this; Windows Dyno has no agent service.

text.tspan: Every start, install, repair, resume and uninstall passes one transition function and writes the record before each OS step. A hold ends when the service answers, the version changes, or the user
presses Repair. macOS and Linux share this; Windows Dyno has no agent service.
